ThisMEMORANDUMOFDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(this“Memorandum") dated as of July 7, 2023 by and between LONG ISLAND UNIVERSITY, a New York educational corporation having an office at 1 University Plaza, Brooklyn, New York 11201 as DEVELOPER TRS LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an office at c/o RXR Realty, 625 RXR Plaza, Uniondale, New York 11556, as developer (together with its permitted successors and assigns, “Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of the land located in Kings County in the City and State of NewYork designated as Block 2085,Lot 15 on the Tax Map of the Kings County,New York,as such premises are more particularly described inExhibit A attached hereto (collectively, the “Land"), together with the building and improvements now or hereafter situated thereon (the "Improvements"; the Land and Improvements herein being referred to collectively as "Premises"); WHEREAS, Owner and Developer are parties to that certain Development Agreement (the “Development Agreement”), dated as of the date hereof, pursuant to which Owner has engaged Developer to construct the Project (as defined in the Development Agreement) on the Premises, including the construction of a mixed-use towerin the location of the“Phase II”Site depicted on Exhibit B attached hereto subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Development Agreement; WHEREAS,pursuantto thetermsof theDevelopmentAgreement,Ownerwill conveya portion of the Premises to RXR 91 DeKalb Owner LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("DeKalb Owner"), an affiliate of Developer, following Substantial Completion of the LIU Facilities(as such terms are defined in theDevelopment Agreement); and WHEREAS, the parties desire to record a memorandum summarizing certain (but not all) of theprovisions,covenants and conditionsset forthin theDevelopmentAgreement. NOW, THEREFORE, Owner and Developer declare as follows: The foregoing recitals are hereby incorporated into this Memorandum as if separately stated herein. 1.
